Just to let u know my neovim configuration has gone through lots of customization, at the moment  i am using this minimalistic neovim and liking it.
There is probably no such thing as the perfect editor configuration. There is only the configuration that makes sense to the people using it.

I like that about neovim. It is a hyperextensible software. but its also a piece of self expression. The editor slowly becames shaped by the things we do, the problems we encounter on the journey,and point to be noted, the way we think.
